transform_request_bedrock_invoke: transform litellm chat messages and params into Bedrock Invoke request format for a provider
transform_response_bedrock_invoke: transform Bedrock Invoke HTTP response into a litellm ModelResponse with usage and content
get_complete_url_bedrock_invoke: get the complete AWS Bedrock runtime URL for invoke or invoke-with-response-stream endpoint
get_bedrock_invoke_provider: extract the Bedrock provider name from a model string like anthropic.claude-3 or us.amazon.nova-pro
convert_messages_to_prompt: convert a list of chat messages into a provider-specific prompt string and optional chat history
